Note B: In Criminal matters, wherever there is conviction or allegation relating to special offences under 1501 to 1511 that would prevail. For example, if there is an allegation of IPC/Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita offences and POCSO offences, the matter would be categorized as 1502. In Criminal matters, if there are 2 special offences invoked. For example, POCSO Act or SC/ST are invoked, the cases fall under the following categories: • Wherever the offence against women, it would fall under 1501. • There is an offence against child [including girl child], the same would come under 1502. • Wherever NDPS Act is invoked, it would come under 1504. • Wherever Money Laundering is invoked, it would fall under 1509.
